journeys.name: Boot and see the project context
journeys.description: Start the TUI in a project and land on a ready prompt with the project, branch, model, and catalogs loaded.

steps: start the TUI in a project directory
wait for the session to load

checkpoints.expect: the home screen shows the prompt, the project directory and git branch in the footer, and the server's model
the model, agent, command, MCP, and skill lists are populated and any migration overlay has finished

journeys.name: Find and run a command from the palette
journeys.description: Open the command palette, search the commands, and run one without remembering its keybind.

steps: type part of a command name

checkpoints.expect: a searchable list of commands grouped by Session, Agent, System
the selected command's dialog or action appears

journeys.name: Open a recent session or project
journeys.description: Use the open menu to return to a recent session or switch to another project.

steps: pick an earlier session or project

checkpoints.expect: a dialog lists recent sessions and projects
the selected session's transcript, or the selected project's home, opens

journeys.name: Toggle the session sidebar
journeys.description: Collapse and restore the sidebar to give the transcript more width.

checkpoints.expect: the right sidebar collapses and the transcript pane widens
the sidebar returns with its previous content

journeys.name: Open the help dialog
journeys.description: Show the keybindings and commands available from the current screen.

checkpoints.expect: a dialog lists the keybindings with their descriptions

journeys.name: View the server and session status
journeys.description: Open the status dialog to read the server version, directory, and current session.

checkpoints.expect: the Status dialog shows the server version, directory, and session id

journeys.name: Switch the theme
journeys.description: Pick a different theme and repaint the whole TUI without restarting.

checkpoints.expect: the theme dialog lists the available themes
the transcript, prompt, and borders repaint in the selected theme

journeys.name: Open settings
journeys.description: Change theme, color mode, and other persisted TUI settings from one dialog.

checkpoints.expect: the settings dialog lists theme, color mode, and experiments
the changed setting applies immediately and survives a restart

journeys.name: View debug information
journeys.description: Show the version, paths, and a copy action for support reports.

checkpoints.expect: the debug dialog shows the version, directory, and a copy hint
a toast confirms the debug info is on the clipboard

journeys.name: View usage statistics
journeys.description: Open the statistics page for session and tool usage counters.

checkpoints.expect: the stats page shows usage counters for the project
the previous route is restored

journeys.name: Open the documentation
journeys.description: Open the OpenCode documentation site from the command palette.

checkpoints.expect: the host browser opens the OpenCode documentation site

journeys.reason: opens the OpenCode documentation site in a host browser; the sandbox has no browser or egress and Maki docs are a different surface

journeys.name: Pair a device
journeys.description: Show the pairing code or URL used to attach another device to the server.

checkpoints.expect: the pair dialog shows a code or URL for the other device

journeys.reason: device pairing goes through the OpenCode web/cloud service; there is no Maki or sandbox counterpart

journeys.name: Exit the application
journeys.description: Leave the TUI and restore the terminal to its previous state.

checkpoints.expect: the TUI exits, the terminal is restored, and the shell prompt returns

journeys.name: Create a new session
journeys.description: Start a fresh session from anywhere in the TUI and send its first prompt.

checkpoints.expect: a new session is created and its empty transcript is shown with the prompt focused
the prompt renders as a user message and its turn starts

journeys.name: Resume a session and see its history
journeys.description: Reopen an earlier session from the session list and render its transcript as it was left.

checkpoints.expect: the list shows earlier sessions with titles and timestamps
the earlier exchange renders in the transcript pane in its original order

journeys.name: Switch between open sessions
journeys.description: Move between open session tabs and jump straight to a session in a quick slot.

checkpoints.expect: the next tab's session becomes active with its transcript
the session in quick slot 2 opens

journeys.name: Rename a session
journeys.description: Give the current session a title that shows in the tab and session list.

checkpoints.expect: the new title shows in the tab, the session list, and the footer

journeys.name: Delete a session
journeys.description: Remove an old session from the session list after confirming the delete.

checkpoints.expect: the session disappears from the list and its tab closes

journeys.name: Pin a session in the list
journeys.description: Pin an important session to the top of the session list.

checkpoints.expect: the session moves to the pinned group with a pin marker

journeys.name: Clear the current session
journeys.description: Start fresh from the current screen without leaving the project.

checkpoints.expect: the transcript is empty and a fresh session prompt is focused

journeys.name: Fork a session from a message
journeys.description: Branch a new session from an earlier point in the transcript.

checkpoints.expect: the dialog lists the session's messages to fork from
a new session opens whose transcript ends at the selected message

journeys.name: Jump to a message in the transcript
journeys.description: Use the timeline to find an earlier message and scroll the transcript to it.

checkpoints.expect: a timeline lists the session's messages
the transcript scrolls to the selected message

journeys.name: Interrupt a running turn
journeys.description: Stop an in-flight turn and keep the partial reply in the transcript.

steps: submit a prompt that starts a long turn

checkpoints.expect: the spinner stops, the partial reply stays, and the transcript marks the turn as interrupted

journeys.name: Queue a prompt while a turn runs
journeys.description: Send another prompt during a running turn and let it start after the current result.

checkpoints.expect: the second prompt shows as queued while the first turn keeps streaming
after the first result, the queued prompt starts its own turn

journeys.name: Manage queued prompts
journeys.description: Inspect, delete, or unqueue prompts waiting behind the running turn.

checkpoints.expect: the dialog lists the queued prompts in delivery order
the deleted prompt no longer runs

journeys.name: Compact a long session
journeys.description: Replace the older turns with a summary so the session fits the model's context.

steps: open a session with a long history

checkpoints.expect: a compaction summary replaces the older turns and the context indicator drops

journeys.name: Undo the previous message
journeys.description: Revert the last exchange and restore its prompt text to the input.

steps: send a prompt and receive a reply

checkpoints.expect: the last exchange leaves the transcript and its prompt text returns to the input

journeys.name: Redo a reverted message
journeys.description: Restore the exchange that was reverted by undo.

checkpoints.expect: the reverted exchange returns to the transcript

journeys.name: Copy session content
journeys.description: Copy the last assistant message, the session id, or the whole transcript to the clipboard.

steps: open a session with an assistant reply
copy the session id from the palette
copy the transcript from the palette

checkpoints.expect: a toast confirms the last assistant message is on the clipboard
a toast confirms the transcript is on the clipboard

journeys.name: Export a session transcript
journeys.description: Save the session as Markdown or JSON, with options for thinking and tool output.

checkpoints.expect: the dialog asks for format, thinking, tools, and copy or save
the file is written and its path is shown

journeys.name: Background a blocking tool
journeys.description: Move a long blocking tool call to the background so the session stays usable.

steps: start a turn that runs a long blocking tool

checkpoints.expect: the blocking tool is backgrounded and progress continues in the transcript
the status line shows the session has a backgrounded tool

journeys.name: Open a subagent session
journeys.description: Follow a subagent's transcript and return to the parent session.

steps: start a turn that spawns a subagent

checkpoints.expect: the subagent picker lists the child sessions
the parent transcript is shown again

journeys.name: Ask a side question
journeys.description: Get a one-shot answer from the session's context without adding a turn to the conversation.

checkpoints.expect: the answer appears beside the conversation without adding a turn to the transcript

journeys.name: Review the session diff
journeys.description: Open the diff viewer and read the files the agent changed in this session.

steps: open a session where the agent edited files

checkpoints.expect: the diff viewer lists changed files with additions and deletions
the selected file's hunks render with line numbers

journeys.name: Open a terminal pane
journeys.description: Open a terminal beside the transcript and run a command in the sandbox.

steps: run a command in the terminal

checkpoints.expect: a terminal pane opens beside the transcript
the command's output renders in the pane

journeys.name: View a shell tool's output
journeys.description: Open the shell output for a command the agent ran and read its stdout and stderr.

steps: submit a prompt that runs a shell tool
select the shell in the composer

checkpoints.expect: the composer lists the running shell
the shell output dialog shows the command's stdout and stderr

journeys.name: Send a prompt and watch the reply stream
journeys.description: Submit a prompt and see the assistant reply stream into the transcript.

checkpoints.expect: the prompt renders as a user message above the assistant reply
the assistant reply streams into the transcript and ends in the finished state

acceptedDiffs.reason: the tab shows the title Maki gives a session, its first prompt cut by generate_title (maki-storage sessions.rs v0.6.4 L677–L695), written when the first run is recorded (maki-agent session.rs L143–L166); the reference title "Journey" is the mock model's answer to OpenCode's title request, a model-generated title Maki does not make

journeys.name: Attach an image to a prompt
journeys.description: Paste or attach an image and send it with the prompt.

steps: paste an image into the prompt

checkpoints.expect: the prompt shows an image attachment chip
the image is sent with the prompt and the reply can refer to it

journeys.name: Mention a file in a prompt
journeys.description: Use @-autocomplete to point the agent at a project file.

checkpoints.expect: an autocomplete list of project files appears
the file mention is highlighted in the prompt

journeys.name: Mention a skill in a prompt
journeys.description: Pick a skill from the skill selector and add it to the prompt.

checkpoints.expect: the skill selector lists the skills the server announced
the skill appears as a mention in the prompt

journeys.name: Compose a prompt in an external editor
journeys.description: Hand the current prompt to $EDITOR and bring the edited text back.

checkpoints.expect: the external editor opens with the current prompt text
the edited text is back in the prompt with mentions intact

journeys.name: Stash and restore a prompt
journeys.description: Park a draft, start another prompt, and bring the stashed draft back later.

checkpoints.expect: the prompt empties and the draft appears in the stash list
the stashed prompt returns to the input

journeys.name: Adjust the transcript display
journeys.description: Cycle verbosity, toggle thinking blocks, and group related tool calls.

checkpoints.expect: the transcript switches between low, medium, and high verbosity
thinking blocks and tool grouping change visibility without losing the transcript

journeys.name: Allow a tool once
journeys.description: Approve a pending permission request for a single tool call.

steps: prompt Maki to edit a file

checkpoints.expect: the prompt shows the tool, the file, and the proposed diff
the tool runs and the transcript shows it completed

acceptedDiffs.reason: Maki titles a session only when its first run is recorded (maki-agent session.rs v0.6.4 L143–L166, L203–L217), so mid-run the tab correctly has no title yet; OpenCode titles in parallel with the first model call and the mock answers "Journey"

the tab shows the title Maki gives a session, its first prompt cut by generate_title (maki-storage sessions.rs v0.6.4 L677–L695), written when the first run is recorded (maki-agent session.rs L143–L166); the reference title "Journey" is the mock model's answer to OpenCode's title request, a model-generated title Maki does not make; the silent command shows Maki's real bash result "Exit code: 0" (plugins/bash/init.lua v0.6.4 L407–L412), where OpenCode's shell tool prints "(no output)" (core/src/shell.ts v2.0.32 L249) — each TUI renders its own tool's result

journeys.name: Allow matching tool calls for the session
journeys.description: Approve a permission request for the rest of the session.

checkpoints.expect: the prompt closes and a later matching tool call does not ask again in this session

journeys.name: Reject a tool with a reason
journeys.description: Reject a pending permission request and tell the agent why.

checkpoints.expect: the tool does not run and the transcript shows the rejection with the reason

journeys.name: Answer an MCP form
journeys.description: Fill the form a tool raises and send the answers back so the tool can continue.

steps: a tool raises an MCP form

checkpoints.expect: the form dialog shows the fields, tabs, and validation
the answers are sent and the tool continues

journeys.name: Switch the model
journeys.description: Pick another model from the provider list and use it for the next turn.

checkpoints.expect: the model dialog lists providers and their models
the footer shows the new model and the next turn uses it

journeys.name: Switch the agent
journeys.description: Choose another agent and see the footer follow the selection.

checkpoints.expect: the agent dialog lists the agents the server announced
the footer shows the selected agent

journeys.name: Switch the model variant
journeys.description: Cycle the current model's variant, such as its thinking effort.

checkpoints.expect: the footer shows the next variant for the current model
the next turn reports the selected variant

journeys.name: Manage MCP servers
journeys.description: List the MCP servers, toggle one, and inspect the resources it exposes.

checkpoints.expect: the dialog lists MCP servers with connected or failed status
the server's state changes and its tools refresh

journeys.name: Manage plugins
journeys.description: List the server's plugins and check for updates.

checkpoints.expect: the plugin dialog lists installed OpenCode plugins, empty when none
the check reports no updates or lists them

journeys.name: Manage workspaces
journeys.description: List worktrees, create one, and move the session into it.

checkpoints.expect: the dialog lists existing worktrees and their changes
the session's location shows the new worktree

journeys.name: Change the working directory
journeys.description: Point the session at another sandbox directory and run the next prompt there.

checkpoints.expect: the footer shows the new directory and the file list reloads
the prompt runs against the new directory

journeys.name: Connect a provider integration
journeys.description: Connect a provider account and make its models selectable.

checkpoints.expect: the dialog lists provider integrations and their connected state
the provider shows connected and its models appear

journeys.reason: provider credentials are bound outside the sandbox through OpenShell provider profiles; entering them in the TUI would break the credential boundary

journeys.name: Reload the configuration
journeys.description: Pick up an edited config file without restarting the TUI.

checkpoints.expect: a toast confirms the configuration reloaded and the TUI reflects it

journeys.name: Update OpenCode
journeys.description: Check for and install a newer OpenCode release from inside the TUI.

checkpoints.expect: the update dialog shows the installed and available versions
the new version is installed and the TUI restarts

journeys.reason: the TUI self-updates from the OpenCode release service; Maki and the bridge image are pinned and updated by the image build, not inside the sandbox

journeys.name: Restart the OpenCode service
journeys.description: Restart the server the TUI is attached to and reattach the event stream.

checkpoints.expect: the service restarts and the event stream reattaches

journeys.reason: restarting the OpenCode service is replaced by the OpenShell sandbox lifecycle; there is no in-sandbox service for the TUI to own and restart

journeys.name: View release highlights
journeys.description: Show the highlights for the installed OpenCode release.

checkpoints.expect: a dialog lists the current release highlights

journeys.reason: release highlights are OpenCode release content delivered with the OpenCode app; Maki has no counterpart release feed
